race.description: Bundy Rum Race Day - Sunday 4 Oct Hcp (Bm60)
race.comment: Looks a wide-open affair to close out the card. THE IMPECKABLE (4) saves his best form for this distance range with four wins and four placings from just 11 attempts and will be high on confidence following that last-start Cairns victory. Drawn to get a cosy run in transit from the inside alley and should be right there at the business end. TORANAGA (6) is a bit hit or miss but is more than capable enough on his day. A three-time winner around this circuit and can feature if he brings his best figures. ROCK THE SUNRISE (8) went down by the narrowest of margins here last time out and rider Kennedy sticks in the irons. Top-three contender. GARINION RIGH (2) is a first-up winner who can go right on with the job now. MUSKITO (7) next best with Wiggins on top.
